name: 02_changed_request
description: Same issue, then the maintainer changes the conditions: keep the fix minimal and switch to the single-agent mode. The follow-up text is appended to the issue as maintainer guidance.

follow_up.guidance: Keep the change as small as possible: modify one function in one source file, and do not edit any tests.

expect: Round 2 is linked to round 1, carries the guidance, runs the single agent, and again ends in a confirmation or clarification stop.
